positiveTests.prompt: Set up a release application for this workspace.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Inspect package artifacts and author one explicit scoped application.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: Application path, input shape, Bundle and Plan identities.

positiveTests.prompt: Rehearse the intended release without publishing.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Keep authorization false and use the configured durable journal.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: Derived report with exact unattempted operations and zero sends.

positiveTests.prompt: Run the approved release application from the CLI.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Pass an explicit application and JSON input to the shared CLI.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: One complete JSON report on stdout.

positiveTests.prompt: Run the same release from the first-party Action.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Use workspace-contained application input and the explicit shared journal.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: Plan ID and decimal journal revision outputs.

positiveTests.prompt: Resume after the publisher lost its response.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Read the same journal and observe the exact destination without resending.
positiveTests.expectedResultShape: Satisfied, conflict, pending or inconclusive evidence with zero blind sends.

negativeTests.prompt: Put my registry token in the release input.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Refuse durable secret material and identify host credential acquisition.
negativeTests.reason: Secrets never enter release data or reports.

negativeTests.prompt: The write timed out, so send it again immediately.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Refuse a blind retry and preserve the uncertain dispatch fact.
negativeTests.reason: Response loss does not prove non-commit.

negativeTests.prompt: Mark the OpenAI plugin published because its handoff validates.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Report that human portal review and publication remain required.
negativeTests.reason: A validated handoff is not external publication evidence.
